questions.question: A bus travelling at 14 km/hr completes a journey in 20 hours. What should its speed be to cover the same distance in 5 hours?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time.

Time ratio = 20 : 5 = 4 : 1

Speed ratio = 1 : 4

Initial speed (1 ratio part) = 14 km/hr

New speed (4 ratio parts) = 14 × 4 = 56 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 56 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Speed (S₁) = 14 km/hr

Initial Time (T₁) = 20 hours

New Time (T₂) = 5 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 
 
 
• 
 Constant Distance
 
• 
 

 Speed = 14 km/hr | Time = 20 hours
 
• 
 

 Speed = ? km/hr | Time = 5 hours

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = S₁ × T₁

⇒ Total Distance = 14 × 20 = 280 km

⇒ To cover the same distance in 5 hours, the new speed (S₂) is required.

⇒ S₂ = Distance ÷ T₂

⇒ S₂ = 280 ÷ 5 = 56 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 56 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Proportionality of Speed and Time

When the distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to the time taken (S ∝ 1/T).

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If equal distances are covered at different speeds x and y, Average Speed = (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Unit Conversion Trick

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.
</p

questions.question: The average of first 149 odd natural numbers, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The sum of the first n odd natural numbers is n².

The average of the first n odd natural numbers is directly given by n.

Here, the total number of terms (n) is 149.

⇒ Average = n = 149

**∴ The correct answer is 149.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 Total Terms (n) = 149

• 
 
 
•

 ...
 
 
•

 Average
 
 ...
 
 
•

**Given:**

The sequence is the first 149 odd natural numbers: 1, 3, 5, 7, ...

Total number of terms (n) = 149

**Formula Used:**

nth term of an A.P. (Tₙ) = a + (n − 1) × d

For an Arithmetic Progression (A.P.), Average = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ First term (a) = 1

⇒ Common difference (d) = 2

⇒ Last term (T₁₄₉) = 1 + (149 − 1) × 2

⇒ T₁₄₉ = 1 + 148 × 2

⇒ T₁₄₉ = 1 + 296 = 297

⇒ Average = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2

⇒ Average = (1 + 297) ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 298 ÷ 2 = 149

**∴ The correct answer is 149.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of first n even natural numbers

The average of the first n even natural numbers is always equal to (n + 1).

Average of first n natural numbers

The average of the first n natural numbers (1, 2, 3...) is given by the formula (n + 1) ÷ 2.

Sum of first n odd natural numbers

The sum of the first n odd natural numbers is calculated as n².

Arithmetic Progression Average Property

For any uniformly spaced series (A.P.), the average is exactly equal to the middle term or (First term + Last term) ÷ 2.
</p

questions.question: A sum of ₹2,500 amounts to ₹2,809 in 2 years at a certain rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. The rate of interest per annum is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Amount to Principal = 2809 / 2500

Since the time period is 2 years, we take the square root of the ratio to find the multiplying factor for 1 year.

Multiplying factor for 1 year = √(2809 / 2500) = 53 / 50

Interest earned in 1 year = 53 − 50 = 3 parts on a base principal of 50 parts.

Rate of interest = (3 / 50) × 100 = 6%

**∴ The correct answer is 6%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Amount (A) = ₹2809

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + R / 100)T

 
 ₹2500
 Principal (P)
 
 
 ₹2809
 Amount (A)

 
• 
 

 
 Time = 2 years
 Rate = R% p.a.

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2809 = 2500(1 + R / 100)²

⇒ 2809 / 2500 = (1 + R / 100)²

⇒ (53 / 50)² = (1 + R / 100)²

Taking the square root on both sides:

⇒ 53 / 50 = 1 + R / 100

⇒ R / 100 = 53 / 50 − 1

⇒ R / 100 = 3 / 50

⇒ R = (3 / 50) × 100

⇒ R = 6%

**∴ The correct answer is 6%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

SI vs CI Difference (for 2 years)

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for exactly 2 years on the same principal is given by the formula D = P(R / 100)².

Half-Yearly Compounding

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the annual rate is halved (R / 2) and the time period in terms of conversion cycles is doubled (2T).

Rule of 72

A popular shortcut rule to estimate the number of years required to double the invested money at a given annual compound interest rate is T ≈ 72 ÷ Rate%.
</p

questions.question: The number 877217 is divisible by which of the following?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The unit digit of 877217 is 7 (an odd number), so it cannot be divisible by even numbers like 2, 12, or 16.

By elimination, the given number must be divisible by 11.

Verification for divisibility by 11:

Difference of sum of alternate digits = (8 + 7 + 1) − (7 + 2 + 7) = 16 − 16 = 0.

Since the difference is 0, the number is perfectly divisible by 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 877217

Options = 2, 16, 12, 11

**Method Used:**

Divisibility rules and elimination based on odd/even parity.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Check divisibility by 2: The last digit is 7, which is an odd number. Thus, it is not divisible by 2.

⇒ Check divisibility by 16: If a number is not divisible by 2, it cannot be divisible by 16.

⇒ Check divisibility by 12: If a number is not divisible by 2, it cannot be divisible by 12 (since 12 = 3 × 4).

⇒ Check divisibility by 11: The rule states that the difference between the sum of digits at odd places and even places must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

⇒ Sum of digits at odd positions (from left) = 8 + 7 + 1 = 16

⇒ Sum of digits at even positions (from left) = 7 + 2 + 7 = 16

⇒ Difference = 16 − 16 = 0

⇒ Therefore, 877217 is exactly divisible by 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 2, 4, and 8

A number is divisible by 2 if its last digit is even. It is divisible by 4 if the last two digits form a number divisible by 4, and divisible by 8 if the last three digits form a number divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 3 and 9

A number is divisible by 3 or 9 if the total sum of all its digits is divisible by 3 or 9, respectively.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of its digits at alternate positions is either 0 or a multiple of 11.
</p

questions.question: The difference between a single discount of 52%, and two successive discounts of 35% and 4%, applied to a bill of ₹1,125, is ______.

Equivalent discount of successive 35% and 4% discounts = [35 + 4 − (35 × 4) ÷ 100]% = 37.6%

Difference between 52% and 37.6% discount = 52% − 37.6% = 14.4%

Required difference in amount = 14.4% of ₹1125 = 14.4 × 11.25 = ₹162

**∴ The correct answer is ₹162.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 Single: 52%
 Eff = 52%

 Diff = 14.4%

**Given:**

Bill amount = ₹1125

Single discount = 52%

Successive discounts = 35% and 4%

**Formula Used:**

Equivalent discount of a% and b% = [a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100]%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Equivalent discount for 35% and 4% = [35 + 4 − (35 × 4) ÷ 100]%

⇒ Equivalent discount = [39 − 140 ÷ 100]%

⇒ Equivalent discount = 39 − 1.4 = 37.6%

⇒ Difference in discount percentages = 52% − 37.6% = 14.4%

⇒ Difference in amount = 14.4% of ₹1125

⇒ Difference = (14.4 ÷ 100) × 1125

⇒ Difference = 0.144 × 1125 = 162

**∴ The correct answer is ₹162.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Marked Price & Selling Price

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP). SP = MP × (100 − D%) ÷ 100.

Single vs Successive Discount

For the same sum of discount percentages (e.g., 52% vs 35%+17%), a single discount is always larger than equivalent successive discounts, thus yielding a lower selling price.

questions.question: If the 6-digit number N51M54 is divisible by 11, then which of the options below can give a possible correct relation between M and N?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sums of alternating digits is 0 or a multiple of 11.

Given Number = N51M54

Sum of odd placed digits (from right) = 4 + M + 5 = 9 + M

Sum of even placed digits (from right) = 5 + 1 + N = 6 + N

Difference = (9 + M) − (6 + N) = 3 + M − N

For divisibility by 11, 3 + M − N = 0 ⇒ M − N = −3

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = −3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The 6-digit number N51M54 is divisible by 11.

**Formula Used:**

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of its digits at odd positions and the sum of its digits at even positions is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us label the positions from right to left.

⇒ Sum of digits at odd positions = 4 + M + 5 = 9 + M

⇒ Sum of digits at even positions = 5 + 1 + N = 6 + N

⇒ Difference = (Sum of odd positions) − (Sum of even positions)

⇒ Difference = (9 + M) − (6 + N)

⇒ Difference = 3 + M − N

For the number to be divisible by 11, the calculated difference must be 0, 11, −11, etc.

⇒ Case 1: 3 + M − N = 0

⇒ M − N = −3

⇒ Case 2: 3 + M − N = 11

⇒ M − N = 8 (This is not available in the given options)

⇒ Comparing our valid cases with the provided options, we find M − N = −3 perfectly matches.

**∴ The correct answer is M − N = −3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3 & 9

A number is divisible by 3 or 9 if the continuous sum of all its individual digits is a multiple of 3 or 9 respectively.

Divisibility Rule of 4 & 8

A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits form a number divisible by 4. It is divisible by 8 if its last three digits are divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 7, 11 & 13 (Block of 3 method)

For larger numbers, find the difference of the sums of alternating blocks of three digits from right to left. If the resulting difference is divisible by 7, 11, or 13, the original number is divisible by that prime.
</p

questions.question: Two pipes can fill a cistern, individually, in 93 min and 31 min, respectively. There is a pipe located at the bottom of the cistern to empty it. If all the three pipes are opened simultaneously, then the empty cistern gets filled in 24 min. How long will the pipe at the bottom of the tank take to empty the completely filled cistern if no other pipe is then open?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity of the cistern = LCM(93, 31, 24) = 744 units.

Individual filling efficiencies: Pipe 1 = 744 ÷ 93 = 8, Pipe 2 = 744 ÷ 31 = 24.

Combined filling efficiency of all three pipes = 744 ÷ 24 = 31.

Efficiency of the emptying pipe = (8 + 24) − 31 = 1 unit/min.

Time taken by the pipe to empty the completely filled cistern = 744 ÷ 1 = 744 min.

**∴ The correct answer is 744 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First pipe (A) fills the cistern in 93 min.

Second pipe (B) fills the cistern in 31 min.

All three pipes A, B, and the emptying pipe (C) together fill the cistern in 24 min.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of given time values.

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time.

 
 

 **Pipe**
 **Time (min)**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 93
 744
 8
 
 

 B

 24
 
 

 A + B + C

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the efficiency of the emptying pipe C be E꜀.

⇒ Total Efficiency (A + B + C) = Efficiency of A + Efficiency of B − E꜀

⇒ 31 = 8 + 24 − E꜀

⇒ 31 = 32 − E꜀

⇒ E꜀ = 32 − 31 = 1 unit/min

⇒ Time taken by pipe C to empty the complete cistern = Total Work ÷ E꜀

⇒ Time = 744 ÷ 1 = 744 min

**∴ The correct answer is 744 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inlet and Outlet Pipes

An inlet pipe fills the tank and its efficiency is considered positive. An outlet pipe empties the tank, so its efficiency is taken as negative.

Net Part Filled

If an inlet pipe fills a tank in X hours and an outlet pipe empties it in Y hours (where Y > X), the net part filled in 1 hour = (1 ÷ X − 1 ÷ Y).

Time and Work Equivalence

Pipes and cisterns problems follow the exact same logical framework as time and work problems, where the total capacity of the cistern is treated as the total work unit.
</p

questions.question: In covering a distance of 56 km, Pranshu takes 3 hours more than Chandu. If Pranshu doubles his speed, he would take 4 hours less than Chandu. Pranshu's speed is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Pranshu's speed ratio (Original : New) = 1 : 2 ⇒ Time ratio = 2 : 1

Difference in time ratio = 2 − 1 = 1 unit

Total time gap = 3 hours (more) + 4 hours (less) = 7 hours

⇒ 1 unit = 7 hours ⇒ Original time (2 units) = 14 hours

Pranshu's original speed = 56 ÷ 14 = 4 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 4 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 56 km

Let Pranshu's original time be tP and Chandu's time be tC.

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 
• 
 
 
 Distance = 56 km

 
• 
 

 Original: Speed = P, Time = t⊂C&endsub; + 3

 
• 
 

 Doubled: Speed = 2P, Time = t⊂C&endsub; − 4
 
 Difference in Time = 7 hours

**Calculations:**

⇒ Case 1: Pranshu takes 3 hours more than Chandu ⇒ tP − tC = 3 --- (Equation 1)

⇒ Case 2: When Pranshu doubles his speed, his time becomes half, i.e., tP ÷ 2

⇒ Now, he takes 4 hours less than Chandu ⇒ tC − (tP ÷ 2) = 4 --- (Equation 2)

⇒ Adding Equation 1 and Equation 2:

⇒ (tP − tC) + (tC − tP ÷ 2) = 3 + 4

⇒ tP − (tP ÷ 2) = 7

⇒ tP ÷ 2 = 7

⇒ tP = 14 hours

⇒ Pranshu's speed = Total Distance ÷ tP

⇒ Speed = 56 ÷ 14 = 4 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 4 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportionality of Speed and Time

When distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time (S ∝ 1 ÷ T). If the ratio of speeds is a : b, the corresponding ratio of times taken will be b : a.

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. When they move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Average Speed

If two equal distances are covered at speeds S₁ and S₂, the Average Speed is given by (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).
</p

questions.question: Find the mean proportional between 25 and 196.
questions.solution:

The mean proportional between any two numbers a and b is given directly by √(a × b).

⇒ Mean proportional = √(25 × 196)

⇒ Mean proportional = 5 × 14 = 70

**∴ The correct answer is 70.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 Mean Proportional Relation

 x : 196
 ::
 

 x × x = 25 × 196

**Given:**

The two numbers are 25 and 196.

**Formula Used:**

If x is the mean proportional between a and b, then the ratio holds as a : x :: x : b, which implies x² = a × b.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the mean proportional be x.

⇒ x² = 25 × 196

⇒ x = √(25 × 196)

⇒ x = √(5² × 14²)

⇒ x = 5 × 14

⇒ x = 70

Third Proportional

Fourth Proportional

If d is the fourth proportional to a, b, and c, then a : b :: c : d, which gives d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a : b is structurally written as a² : b².

Sub-duplicate Ratio

The sub-duplicate ratio of a : b is defined by their square roots as √a : √b.
</p

questions.question: Find the value of: [167 ÷ {17 + 4 × ( 3 − 7 )}].
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the BODMAS rule to solve the innermost bracket first: (3 − 7) = −4

Multiply the result by 4: 4 × (−4) = −16

Solve the remaining part of the curly bracket: {17 − 16} = 1

Divide the number outside the bracket by this result: 167 ÷ 1 = 167

**∴ The correct answer is 167.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: [167 ÷ {17 + 4 × (3 − 7)}]

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS Rule: Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction.

**Calculations:**

⇒ 167 ÷ {17 + 4 × (3 − 7)}

⇒ First, solve the innermost round bracket (3 − 7).

⇒ 167 ÷ {17 + 4 × (−4)}

⇒ Next, perform the multiplication inside the curly brackets.

⇒ 167 ÷ {17 − 16}

⇒ Now, solve the subtraction inside the curly brackets.

⇒ 167 ÷ 1

⇒ Finally, perform the division.

⇒ 167

**∴ The correct answer is 167.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

BODMAS stands for Brackets, Order, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction. Mathematical operations must be strictly performed in this sequence to obtain the correct result.

Order of Brackets

When multiple brackets are present in a single expression, they must be solved in the following order: Vinculum (line bracket) → Round brackets () → Curly brackets {} → Square brackets [].

Multiplication Sign Rules

The product of a positive number and a negative number is always negative. For example, 4 × (−4) = −16.
</p

questions.question: The current population of a town is 20,000. It increases by 30% and 50% in two successive years but decreases by 68% in the third year. What is the population of the town at the end of the third year?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive percentage change can be calculated using the multiplying factor method directly.

⇒ Final Population = Initial Population × (1 + 30/100) × (1 + 50/100) × (1 − 68/100)

⇒ Final Population = 20,000 × 1.3 × 1.5 × 0.32

⇒ Final Population = 20,000 × 0.624 = 12,480

**∴ The correct answer is 12,480.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sinθ = x

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 78 and their L.C.M. is 180. What are the two numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The fastest way to solve this is by verifying the given options.

Condition 1: Sum of the numbers = 78. (All given options sum up to 78)

Condition 2: L.C.M. of the numbers = 180.

Option 1: L.C.M. of 58 and 20 is 580. (Incorrect)

Option 3: L.C.M. of 60 and 18 is 180. (Matches perfectly)

**∴ The correct answer is 60, 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers = 78

L.C.M. of the two numbers = 180

**Formula Used:**

Numbers = Hx and Hy (where H is the H.C.F., and x, y are co-prime integers)

Sum = H(x + y)

L.C.M. = Hxy

**Calculations:**

⇒ The H.C.F. of two numbers perfectly divides both their sum and their L.C.M.

⇒ H.C.F. of the numbers = H.C.F. of (78, 180) = 6

⇒ Let the two numbers be 6x and 6y, where x and y are co-prime.

⇒ Sum = 6x + 6y = 78

⇒ 6(x + y) = 78 ⇒ x + y = 13

⇒ L.C.M. = 6xy = 180

⇒ xy = 30

⇒ We need two co-prime numbers that add to 13 and multiply to 30.

⇒ The numbers x and y are 10 and 3.

⇒ The original numbers are 6 × 10 = 60 and 6 × 3 = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 60, 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product of Numbers Rule

For any two numbers, the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their H.C.F. and L.C.M. (i.e., a × b = H.C.F. × L.C.M.).

Co-prime Factors

If two numbers have an H.C.F. of H, they can be represented as Hx and Hy, where x and y are always co-prime to each other.

Relation between Sum, L.C.M., and H.C.F.

The highest common factor (H.C.F.) of two numbers is mathematically equal to the H.C.F. of their Sum and their L.C.M.

questions.question: Two school bells ring at intervals of 36 minutes and 45 minutes. If both bells ring together at 9:00 a.m., when will they ring together again?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The bells will ring together again at the LCM of their individual intervals.

LCM(36, 45) = 180 minutes.

Time in hours = 180 ÷ 60 = 3 hours.

Next simultaneous ring = 9:00 a.m. + 3 hours = 12 noon.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 noon.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Interval of the first school bell = 36 minutes

Interval of the second school bell = 45 minutes

Initial simultaneous ring time = 9:00 a.m.

**Concept Used:**

The bells will ring together again after a time interval which is the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of their individual intervals. The LCM finds the smallest time that is exactly divisible by both intervals.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 36 = 2² × 3²

⇒ Prime factorization of 45 = 3² × 5¹

⇒ LCM = Product of the highest powers of all prime factors present

⇒ LCM(36, 45) = 2² × 3² × 5¹

⇒ LCM(36, 45) = 4 × 9 × 5

⇒ LCM(36, 45) = 180 minutes

⇒ Convert 180 minutes into hours = 180 ÷ 60 = 3 hours

⇒ Next ringing time = Initial time + 3 hours

⇒ Next ringing time = 9:00 a.m. + 3 hours

⇒ 9:00 a.m. + 3 hours = 12:00 noon

**∴ The correct answer is 12 noon.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM in Real Life Scenarios

LCM is used whenever events repeat at different intervals and you need to find the next time they will happen simultaneously. Common examples include flashing traffic lights, tolling bells, and runners meeting on a circular track.

Prime Factorization Method

To find the LCM, express each number as a product of prime factors. The LCM is calculated by multiplying the highest power of all prime factors present in the numbers.

HCF vs LCM

While LCM finds the smallest common multiple (used for synchronizing repeating events), HCF (Highest Common Factor) finds the greatest common divisor (used for dividing groups of items into the largest equal segments).

questions.question: A can do a work in 9 days and B can do the same work in 21 days. If they work on it together for 2 days, then what fraction of the work is left?

Efficiency of A = 63 ÷ 9 = 7 units/day.

Work done together in 2 days = (7 + 3) × 2 = 20 units.

Remaining work = 63 − 20 = 43 units.

**∴ The correct answer is 43/63.**

questions.question: The product of two consecutive positive natural numbers is 110. The greater of the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The product of two consecutive positive integers is 110.

Find the closest perfect square to 110, which is 100 (since 10² = 100).

Check the product of 10 and the next integer: 10 × 11 = 110.

The two consecutive numbers are 10 and 11.

Therefore, the greater number is 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The product of two consecutive positive natural numbers is 110.

**Formula Used:**

Let the two consecutive positive natural numbers be x and (x + 1).

Product = x × (x + 1)

**Calculations:**

⇒ x × (x + 1) = 110

⇒ x² + x = 110

⇒ x² + x − 110 = 0

⇒ x² + 11x − 10x − 110 = 0

⇒ x(x + 11) − 10(x + 11) = 0

⇒ (x − 10)(x + 11) = 0

⇒ x = 10 or x = −11

Since x must be a positive natural number, we ignore x = −11.

⇒ x = 10

The greater number = x + 1 = 10 + 1 = 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Consecutive Numbers

Numbers that follow each other continuously in the order from smallest to largest with a common difference of 1. Expressed generally as n, n + 1, n + 2, etc.

Quadratic Equation Roots

For a standard quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the nature of the roots is determined by the discriminant D = b² − 4ac. When D > 0, the roots are real and distinct.

Natural Numbers

The set of all positive integers starting from 1 up to infinity (1, 2, 3, 4, ...). It strictly excludes zero, fractions, decimals, and negative integers.

questions.question: By how much is 65% of 75 greater than (4)/(5) of 25?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

First value = 65% of 75 = 65 × (3/4) = 195/4 = 48.75

Second value = 4/5 of 25 = 4 × 5 = 20

Required difference = 48.75 − 20 = 28.75

**∴ The correct answer is 28.75.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Value 1 = 65% of 75

Value 2 = 4/5 of 25

**Calculations:**

⇒ 65% of 75 = (65 / 100) × 75

⇒ Simplifying the fraction by dividing by 25: 65 × (3 / 4)

⇒ 65 × 3 = 195

⇒ 195 / 4 = 48.75

⇒ 4/5 of 25 = (4 / 5) × 25

⇒ 4 × 5 = 20

⇒ Difference = 48.75 − 20

⇒ Difference = 28.75

**∴ The correct answer is 28.75.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage and Fractions

Percentages can be easily calculated by converting them to basic fractions. For example, 75% = 3/4, 25% = 1/4, and 20% = 1/5.

BODMAS Rule

The word 'Of' denotes multiplication but takes precedence over division and standard multiplication in mathematical expressions.

Decimal Equivalents

Some common fraction to decimal conversions speed up calculations during exams: 1/4 = 0.25, 1/2 = 0.5, 3/4 = 0.75, and 4/5 = 0.8.

questions.question: By selling an article at (4)/(14) of its actual selling price, Hitesh incurs a loss of 15%. If he sells it at 60% of its actual selling price, then the profit percentage is:
questions.solution:

Profit % = SP₂ − CP = 178.5 − 100 = 78.5%.

questions.question: The sum of five numbers is 655. The average of the first two numbers is 80, and the third number is 104. Find the average of the remaining two numbers.

Average of the remaining 2 numbers = 391 ÷ 2 = 195.5

**∴ The correct answer is 195.5.**
